name: Extraordinary Kids Therapy Therapeutic Summer Camp
description_short: A therapeutic summer day camp run by Extraordinary Kids Therapy, a pediatric therapy practice in Chepachet (Glocester), RI, for children of all abilities. Full-day and half-day options; each week has a theme (Farm Week, Shark Week, Zoo Camp and more) that guides therapy, activities and special events. Full day is capped at 20 children per week.
refund_policy_summary: Apply by email; once staff accept the application you pay a $50 non-refundable deposit for each week you register. No other refund terms are stated.
special_needs_notes: This is a therapeutic camp run by a pediatric therapy practice. Weekly themes "guide our treatment, activity planning, and special events," and the camp describes itself as an inclusive environment for children of all abilities.

Contact page: 'Contact Details 389 Putnam Pike Chepachet, RI 02814'; 401-203-5444. Chepachet is a village of Glocester (city set to Glocester for our town list).
